restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอเด็ก-หมออนุชิต เวชกรรมเฉพาะทาง
text: I've been there twice already and have been impressed both times. The doctor, pharmacist, and all the staff at the clinic provide excellent service. They chat with my child and everyone is always smiling, which is truly impressive. The doctor gives great advice and conducts thorough examinations. The medication we received last time was very effective. This time, my child only cried for a short time before coming home without a fever. The prices are also very reasonable. Once again, I would like to express my appreciation. 🩷🩷
author_name: บัญจรัตน์ ชุมชวด
